column2: [intro]
At the ball of illusions, I dance without rest
On the notes of lies, on the steps of the cowardly
I get drunk on dreams, I lose myself in illusion
But deep down, I feel a profound confusion
The ball of illusions, spins endlessly
Masks hide, concealing their true intentions
I twirl, I whirl, carried by the melody
But in the midst of this dance, I feel so wounded
At the ball of illusions, I meet familiar faces
Seductive glances, enchanting smiles
But behind these masks, reality hides
Broken hearts, scarred souls, betrayed lives
